meta.description: Two plans for independent estate agents in Spain: Free for up to {limit} clients with every feature, and Pro for unlimited clients from €{price} a month plus IVA.

pricingPage.heading: Free to start. One plan when you grow.
pricingPage.subheading: Every feature on both plans. The only difference is how many clients you can hold. Nothing you've added is ever deleted.

features.heading: Every feature, on both plans
features.body: Nothing is held back for Pro. The plan only changes how many clients you can hold at once.

pipeline.title: Pipeline
pipeline.body: Move every buyer and seller through clear stages, from new to reserved.

clients.title: Client cards
clients.body: Language, nationality, budget and notes, with hot and cold flags.

viewings.title: Viewings and offers
viewings.body: Log every property a client sees, with photos, and record each offer against the asking price.

documents.title: Documents
documents.body: Contracts, IDs and reservation papers filed against the right client.

agencies.title: Multi-agency
agencies.body: Tag each lead by agency, so one book covers every agency you sell for.

ai.title: AI follow-ups
ai.body: Warm WhatsApp and email drafts in the client's language. You read and approve before anything is sent.

autoEngage.title: Auto-engage
autoEngage.body: Spots the clients going quiet and hands you a nudge that is ready to send.

matching.title: Buyer to listing matching
matching.body: Shows which of your listings fit a buyer's budget, property type and bedrooms.

portals.title: Portal lead capture
portals.body: Paste an enquiry from Idealista, Fotocasa or Kyero and it becomes a filled-in lead.

calendar.title: Calendar and confirmations
calendar.body: Month view with reminders, a Google Calendar feed and one-tap WhatsApp confirmations.

tools.title: Templates and calculator
tools.body: Your own message templates, plus the profit calculator for sellers.

app.title: English, Spanish, installable
app.body: Switch the interface language whenever you like, and install it on your phone's home screen.

founding.title: How the founding price works
founding.body: The first {cap} agents who subscribe pay €{price} a month for as long as they stay on Pro. Once those spots are gone the price is €{standard} a month.

referrals.title: Free months for referrals
referrals.body: Share your referral link with the agents you co-broke with. Once you are both on Pro, you each get a free month.

cancel.title: Cancel any time, keep your data
cancel.body: Cancel in the billing portal in a couple of clicks. Nothing is deleted: the Free limit of {limit} clients simply applies again.

cta.heading: Start with your next lead
cta.body: Add a client, take one deal through the pipeline and decide later. No card to start, and no time limit.
